seoTitle: MCPS Calendar 2025-2026: Montgomery County Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the MCPS 2025-2026 traditional school calendar with first day, last day, holidays, early release days, Winter Break, Spring Break, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Montgomery County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 traditional school year on August 26, 2025 and ends on June 17, 2026 with an early release day. Student Transition Day is August 25, 2025. Winter Break runs December 24, 2025 through January 2, 2026, and Spring Break runs March 30 through April 6, 2026. The official calendar also lists professional days, non-instructional days, grading and planning days, early release days, systemwide closures, and possible make-up instructional days. The PDF notes that the traditional calendar does not apply to Arcola Elementary School.

calendarFaqs.q: When does MCPS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Montgomery County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 traditional school year for students on Tuesday, August 26, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: What is MCPS Student Transition Day in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Student Transition Day is Monday, August 25, 2025. It is a non-instructional full day for selected transition grades and students new to a school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Wednesday, December 24, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 30 through Monday, April 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for MCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Wednesday, June 17, 2026, and it is listed as an early release day.
